title: Marketing Lab Truth and Five-Dimension Quality Evaluator

notes: Adds a Kairo-owned, candidate-identity-blind evaluator for already-collected synthetic/public-safe Marketing Lab paired evidence.
The evaluator uses the existing AgentRuntimePort critic role with zero tools and a fixed Kairo rubric; neither candidate can self-award benchmark evidence.
Truth must fail when visible candidate content asserts factual, technical, experiential, quantitative, causal, model-specific or capability details not entailed by the supplied benchmark Claims.
Quality evidence is bounded to the existing brandFit, hookQuality, originality, formatQuality and criticScore dimensions; benchmark thresholds and comparator policy are unchanged.
No human preference, edit-distance evidence, final verdict, VS-23/VS-24 activation, API wiring, migration, deployment or production enablement is in scope.

approvals.rationale: Owner said Go after the VS-64 to VS-65 handoff and evaluator implementation were stated as the immediate next governed action; issue #116 records the exact evaluator scope and constraints.

VS-65 does not change benchmark thresholds, candidate eligibility, advancement policy, human-evidence requirements or production permissions; it implements the already-required Kairo-owned Truth and five-dimension evidence contract.
Implementation head b7f5d158ad79d472a4978b7cb9be18469bc20d19 passed Product Intake #651, Security #750 and CI #882 after the JsonValue contract correction. No production execution occurred.
Certification candidate is frozen after the green implementation head; final exact-head Product Intake, Security and CI must pass before certification approval can be requested.
No release, merge or deployment is authorized by VS-65 implementation approval.
No production evaluator execution or production enablement is authorized.

evidence: Implementation head b7f5d158ad79d472a4978b7cb9be18469bc20d19: Product Intake #651 PASS; Security #750 PASS; CI #882 PASS.
CI #882 passed clean PostgreSQL 18 migrations through 0022, production dependency audit, governance/preflight, worker/API/web typecheck, runtime tests/builds and dashboard build.

Evaluator regression coverage proves candidate identity is absent from model context, zero tools/capabilities, fixed candidate-neutral rubric, bounded Truth/quality evidence, Claim-lineage prevalidation and fail-closed malformed output/provenance handling.
Groq GPT-OSS strict structured output now enforces the marketing-pair-quality-evaluation@1 response shape without changing benchmark thresholds or advancement policy.

postRelease.expectedOutcome: Kairo can produce independently validated Truth and five-dimension quality evidence for each synthetic Marketing Lab pair without exposing candidate identity or granting tools/production authority.
metrics: candidate identity fields exposed to evaluator
